name: Pixel
summary: At Splintertree Post, Pixel carries Warsong goods through dangerous lands for a fee. She keeps the saw blades until she is paid, and looks for other cargo worth carrying.

sections.title: Business in the Deep Woods
sections.body: Pixel carries freight for the Warsong Clan from Splintertree Post, where the Horde holds a fortified post in Ashenvale. She takes goods through active war zones to support the clan’s logging work, but coin and contracts guide her choices. The saw blades stay with her until she receives payment. For this shipment, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to guard herself on the road. Pixel also pays travelers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.

faq.answer: Pixel is a goblin courier working from Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale. She carries cargo through dangerous lands and has a shipment of saw blades for the Warsong logging effort.

faq.q: Why won't Pixel hand over the saw blades immediately?
faq.answer: Pixel holds on to the saw blades until she receives payment or trade goods to cover her fee. Even with the Horde’s urgent needs in Ashenvale, she sticks to her business terms.

faq.q: Why does she want satyr horns?
faq.answer: Pixel wants satyr horns because they are in high demand in Ratchet, where she is headed next. She cannot take on the satyrs of Night Run, Satyrnaar and Xavian herself, so she pays travelers to gather horns for her to sell.

faq.q: Is Pixel officially a member of the Horde?
faq.answer: Pixel works with the Horde at Splintertree Post through profitable contracts for the Warsong logging operations. Her chief loyalty is to trade, profit and fulfilling her delivery agreements.

angles.text: As a Horde champion helping establish a foothold in Ashenvale, you can rely on Pixel to supply the industrial hardware the Warsong Clan needs to keep its logging machinery running.
